summary: Presents a technique to securely provision a networking device that boots in a factory-default state. It can update the boot image, commit an initial configuration, and run scripts, and it works on both public and private networks. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: A new router in a box has to learn its settings. This is a safe way for it to get them as soon as it is plugged in, and to check that the instructions are really from its owner.
